lidar_sampling.scope: Every eligible local return indexed in sparse 0.25 m 3-D cells, including ground and vegetation. Original class-1/6 XYZ additionally retained. Class 1 is unclassified evidence, not automatically a building or ride. Vegetation is not structural height truth. Finer bins do not add observations.

limits: Quarter-metre sampling is evidence resolution; the world remains 1 m horizontally, using half-block structural surfaces.
Source gaps and occluded geometry remain unknown. Class 1 is retained evidence, not automatically a structure.
Existing ride heights/supports/stations remain provisional. No client import or independently surveyed accuracy test is claimed.

world_lidar_geometry.fit_metric: Residual to accepted survey layer medians, not held-out or independent physical accuracy.
world_lidar_geometry.geometry_policy: All eligible source returns indexed across the complete park frame. Supported class-6 surfaces alter geometry inside and outside mapped building footprints. No global 3x3 median filter on observed roofs. Separate observed height layers retained. Protected Wicker, ride/guideway and reference corridors unchanged; unseen geometry is not completed.

park_wide_ground_and_vegetation.foliage_detail_limit: All eligible foliage returns already supplied native 1 m occupancy. Finer evidence cannot create additional observed tree detail at this block scale.
park_wide_ground_and_vegetation.terrain_policy: Weighted median of every class-2 return through 0.25 m height bins; at least 3 returns; reject >1.5 m mixed heights or DTM disagreement. Preserve water, bridges, buildings and protected references.

structures_outside_mapped_buildings.policy: Every supported class-6 half-height layer outside mapped buildings; no solid extrusion, footprint completion or gap interpolation. Protected references, water, bridges and path headroom excluded. Materials are RGB appearance proxies.
